description: Create a structured behavioral observation log from scattered family notes about a parent with Alzheimer's disease. The raw notes are in /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/mom_observations_raw.txt. Create a professional medical document at /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/mom_behavioral_log_neuro.docx that organizes incidents by date, identifies behavior categories (Memory, Safety, Mood/Agitation, Orientation, ADL), includes pattern analysis, and lists questions for the neurologist. The document should be suitable for a medical appointment.
